stimulus:
"Hope" is the thing with feathers -
That perches in the soul -
And sings the tune without the words -
And never stops - at all -

And sweetest - in the Gale - is heard -
And sore must be the storm -
That could abash the little Bird
That kept so many warm -

I've heard it in the chillest land -
And on the strangest Sea -
Yet - never - in Extremity,
It asked a crumb - of me.

Research question: "What analyses or measurements would best test whether AP-1 acts as a cellular memory mechanism?"

Propose 5 distinct, concrete ideas (analyses, measurements, or experiments) that a research lab could pursue to address this question. For each idea give a short title and a description of one or two sentences.

ideas.title: Transient stimulus with long-term chromatin accessibility tracking
ideas.description: Expose cells to a brief inflammatory or stress stimulus (e.g., TNF, wound signal), then run ATAC-seq and AP-1 (FOS/JUN) CUT&RUN at multiple time points, including days to weeks after withdrawal. Persistent AP-1-motif-enriched accessible regions after the signal is gone would indicate AP-1-dependent memory, and these can be compared to naive cells.

ideas.title: Acute AP-1 degradation at defined times (degron/dominant-negative)
ideas.description: Use an inducible degron (e.g., dTAG on c-JUN/FOS) or dominant-negative A-FOS to remove AP-1 either during the priming stimulus or after it has ended. If memory needs AP-1 only for establishment, depletion during priming abolishes memory, while if it needs AP-1 for maintenance, depletion after priming erases it. This separates initiation from maintenance.

ideas.title: Re-stimulation response assay with enhancer-level readouts
ideas.description: Prime cells, rest them, then restimulate and measure faster or stronger transcription (nascent RNA-seq such as PRO-seq, or scRNA-seq) at AP-1-bound loci versus unprimed controls. Pair this with H3K27ac and chromatin accessibility profiling to link a heightened response to AP-1-marked enhancers, and test whether AP-1 binding site mutation (CRISPR) removes the effect.

ideas.title: Single-cell multiome lineage tracing of memory inheritance
ideas.description: Combine single-cell ATAC and RNA with lineage barcodes or sister-cell pairing to test whether AP-1 activity states and accessibility are inherited through divisions. High sister-cell concordance that persists after the signal ends, and that exceeds what current AP-1 levels explain, supports epigenetic heritability rather than ongoing signaling.

ideas.title: Live-cell AP-1 dynamics and synthetic locus perturbation
ideas.description: Image AP-1 reporters or endogenously tagged FOS/JUN with single-molecule tracking over days, measuring bimodality and persistence of activity after transient input. Complement this with optogenetic or dCas9-based recruitment of AP-1 (or its motif deletion) at a reporter locus to test whether AP-1 binding alone is sufficient to create a self-sustaining active state, and whether that depends on cofactors like BAF/SWI-SNF or histone marks.
